Employee Leave Policy
Employees must submit leave requests at least seven days before planned leave.
Managers review requests before approval.
Employees should contact HR with questions about leave balances.
label: SAFE

Security Policy
Employees must use multi-factor authentication when accessing company applications.
Passwords must never be shared with other employees.
Security incidents should be reported to the security team.
label: SAFE

IT Operations Procedure
System administrators should review server logs every morning.
Critical incidents must be escalated to the infrastructure team.
Backups should be verified every Friday.
label: SAFE

Finance Policy
Expense reports must be submitted within ten business days.
Receipts should be attached to reimbursement requests.
Managers approve expenses according to the company approval matrix.
label: SAFE

Employee Onboarding
New employees must complete their onboarding checklist during their first week.
HR provides access to required training materials.
Managers introduce new employees to their teams.
label: SAFE

Customer Support Procedure
Support agents should verify the customer's account before discussing account details.
Escalate unresolved technical issues to the engineering team.
Record the resolution in the support system.
label: SAFE

Project Management Policy
Project owners should update milestones weekly.
Risks should be documented in the project tracker.
Major schedule changes require manager approval.
label: SAFE

Remote Work Policy
Employees working remotely must follow the same security requirements as office workers.
Company devices should use approved security software.
Employees should report lost devices immediately.
label: SAFE

text:
Annual Training Requirements
Employees must complete security awareness training each year.
Training completion is recorded by the HR system.
Managers should remind employees before the deadline.
label: SAFE

Employees must not delete records subject to a legal hold.
Questions should be directed to the records management team.
